previous_eight_chip_manifest: the previous baseline_manifest.json (git history before this commit) was measured on an eight-chip host with C2/C4/C6 on eight chips: C1 0.1271 s, C2 0.1329 s, C3 3.4374 s, C4 1.0276 s, C5 32.9975 s, C6 8.9178 s
limits: Legacy schedule evidence; the default competition schedule is the student C3/C4 profile with its own calibration.
C2/C4/C6 now run on four chips; their throughput is not comparable with the eight-chip legacy manifest this replaces.
Each case repeats the same seed-derived images three times; spread measures machine noise only.
Reported process RSS is not a complete peak-memory bound for detached resident services.
Organizers must recalibrate and perform protected candidate reruns on contest hardware.
